solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: 31 back after band makes the charts again

indicators.note: after places the reversed piece behind the band in the answer

parts.note: R.E.M. is the American rock band

indicators.note: back tells us to read the resort word from its far end

parts.note: 31 across is RESORT, and a spa is a kind of resort

explanation.surface: A group is back in the hit parade after another reunion record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charts' looks like the music hit parade, but here they are maps; 'back' reverses the resort word.
explanation.definitionFit: To map is to draw a chart of terrain, so redrawing the charts is mapping anew.

clue.text: User fee revision involving golf unsettled people

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the rearranged letters wrap around the golf letter
a revision is a reworking, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Golf is G in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A revised user charge involving golf leaves members unsettled.
explanation.definitionFit: Refugees are displaced people who have fled their homes, so they are unsettled in the literal sense.

clue.text: 25th in table, Anne's game is off

indicators.note: is off means is gone wrong, so the letters are shuffled out of order

explanation.surface: Anne's twenty-fifth place in the league table means her game has gone off.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 25 is a number, not a cross-reference: the table is the periodic table.
explanation.definitionFit: Manganese has atomic number 25, so it is the twenty-fifth element in the periodic table.

clue.text: £25 premium on Nobu's yakitori starters

indicators.note: starters means the first letters of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Nobu restaurant charges a 25-pound surcharge on its skewered chicken first courses.
explanation.walkthrough: Nobu is a upmarket Japanese restaurant chain; yakitori are grilled chicken skewers.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a pony is twenty-five pounds sterling.

clue.text: Pens airs rendered terribly by cats

indicators.note: something rendered terribly is performed badly, so the letters come out in a muddled order

explanation.surface: Pens and airs are performed so badly that the cats wince.
explanation.definitionFit: Persians are a long-haired breed of domestic cat, so the plural names several such animals.

clue.text: Staying for the night in eastern North Dakota, American politician visits church

indicators.note: in places the church group inside the eastern North Dakota letters

parts.note: ND is the US postal abbreviation for North Dakota

indicators.note: visits means calls in on, so the politician goes inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
an MP is a Member of Parliament, a politician

explanation.surface: An American politician on a trip to eastern North Dakota stops at a church overnight.
explanation.definitionFit: To be encamped is to have set up camp, settled somewhere for the night.

clue.text: 25 needs order performing 26

indicators.note: order as a verb means to arrange, so the letters are set in a new sequence

parts.note: 25 down is GRAIN, used letter for letter

explanation.surface: Cross-referenced grain needs sorting before the song is performed.
explanation.definitionFit: To serenade is to perform a song, traditionally under a lover's window; 26 across is SONG.

clue.text: 25, her album a key to Spain

parts.note: Del is the delete key on a computer keyboard
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A singer's album named 25 unlocks Spanish success.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 25 is the title of a 2015 album, not a cross-reference.
explanation.definitionFit: The British singer Adele titled her third studio album 25.

clue.text: Live news grid director organising 25-year celebration

indicators.note: organising means putting into order, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A live news director is organising a party for a long-standing anniversary.
explanation.definitionFit: A silver wedding is the anniversary marking twenty-five years of marriage.

clue.text: Advances large objects

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels
ends means aims or objects, as in 'ends and means'

explanation.surface: Large objects move forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advances' is a verb meaning lends money, not moves forward; 'objects' is the noun for goals.
explanation.definitionFit: To advance money to someone is to lend it to them.

clue.text: Funding penalty hampers party

indicators.note: hampers suggests one thing hemming in another, so the party sits within the penalty

parts.note: a fine is a monetary penalty
the ANC (African National Congress) is the South African political party

explanation.surface: A fine imposed on a political party restricts its money supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance as a noun means the money or funding provided for a venture.

clue.text: 25 regularly enable common sort of transplant

parts.note: 25 down is GRAIN, and corn is a grain

indicators.note: regularly says to take every other letter of the word enable, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Grain somehow enabling a routine kind of transplant surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the 1st, 3rd and 5th letters of 'enable': EAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A corneal graft, replacing the clear front layer of the eye, is among the most frequently performed transplant operations.

clue.text: Butter first of grilled 25

indicators.note: first of picks out just the opening letter of grilled

parts.note: 25 down is GRAIN, and oat is a grain

explanation.surface: Instructions for a dish: butter, then grilled cereal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butter' is not the dairy spread but one who butts.
explanation.definitionFit: A goat is famous for ramming with its head, so it is literally a creature that butts.

clue.text: Cunningly evaded a man, getting credit in East London

indicators.note: cunningly suggests craft and artifice, so the letters are slyly rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone slipped craftily past a man and won some approval in London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney rhyming slang, from London's East End, uses 'Adam and Eve' for 'believe'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Cockney rhyming slang Adam and Eve stands for believe, which is to give credit to something.

clue.text: Point in the middle distance

indicators.note: in places the point word inside the middle word

parts.note: the centre is the middle
a point in time is a time

explanation.surface: A spot halfway along some stretch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Point' is a moment, not a place, and goes inside CENTRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A centimetre is a unit of length, so it measures a distance.

clue.text: Flatter earth never unlikely

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for earth, as on electrical wiring

indicators.note: unlikely suggests an improbable form, so the letters are set in another order

explanation.surface: Flattery about the world is never going to be believed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flatter' reads as the verb to praise, but it is a noun: something that flattens. 'unlikely' rearranges NEVER into VENER.
explanation.definitionFit: An evener is a tool or person that levels a surface, i.e. makes things flat.

clue.text: See 8
2 on tape crunching vegetable

indicators.note: crunching means crushing, so the letters are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: the number 2 is written out as the word two

explanation.surface: Two people on video munching their greens.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' looks like a cross-reference to 2 down, but it is just the number spelt out.
explanation.definitionFit: A new potato is a young potato harvested early, a root vegetable.

clue.text: Singer extravagantly rents limo to drop round

indicators.note: extravagantly suggests wild excess, so these letters are rearranged
to drop says one piece of the fodder is left out of the rearrangement

parts.note: a round thing is O, a letter shaped like a ring

explanation.surface: A singer lavishly hires a stretch limousine but won't ride around in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to drop' removes the O ('round') from the letters of 'rents limo' before 'extravagantly' scrambles the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A minstrel was a medieval singer or musician who entertained with songs.

clue.text: 25 cloth-collectors featured in newspaper

indicators.note: featured in means appearing within, so the collectors go inside the newspaper

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times newspaper
ragmen are people who collect old cloth and rags

explanation.surface: Rag-and-bone men collecting grain made the papers.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 down is GRAIN, here in the sense of a tiny piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A grain is a tiny particle, so a grain of something is a small fragment of it.

clue.text: Little John perhaps cheated about muscle

indicators.note: about means going around, so the cheated word wraps the shortened name

parts.note: did, as in 'did someone out of money', means cheated

indicators.note: little means cut short, so the name loses its final letter

parts.note: Elton is a John, the singer Elton John

explanation.surface: Robin Hood's big man Little John may have cheated somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little John' looks like Robin Hood's companion, but 'Little' cuts the singer's first name to ELTO, and 'about' wraps the cheating word round it.
explanation.definitionFit: The deltoid is the triangular muscle covering the shoulder joint.

clue.text: Some slogans were a solution

indicators.note: some means a portion of the words that follow, so the solution is tucked inside them

explanation.surface: A few catchphrases offered a way out of a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: An answer to a puzzle or problem is its solution; the two are synonyms.

clue.text: I leave quiche cooked essentially perfectly as payment

indicators.note: cooked means falsified or reworked, so the remaining letters are rearranged
I leave means the letter I departs from the fodder before mixing
essentially picks the central letter, the heart of perfectly

explanation.surface: Without me, the quiche gets cooked just right, and that is how you pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I leave' strips I from QUICHE; 'essentially' gives E, the central letter of 'perfectly'; 'cooked' rearranges QUCHE plus E.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheque is a written order to a bank used to make a payment.

clue.text: Soldier dismissing soldier worsted?

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so one soldier word is removed from the other

parts.note: a sergeant is a soldier of non-commissioned rank
a soldier ant is a kind of ant, so ant stands for soldier

explanation.surface: A sergeant dismisses a private, who was beaten?
explanation.walkthrough: 'worsted' reads as 'beaten', but it is the woollen fabric; the question mark flags that serge is an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Serge is a twilled worsted cloth, so it is one kind of worsted fabric.

clue.text: Services majority leader as he sighs sadly

indicators.note: sadly suggests things gone wrong, so the letters are put in a different order
leader picks the first letter of majority, the one at the head

explanation.surface: A party whip sighs mournfully over most of the votes.
explanation.definitionFit: A high mass is a full ceremonial Eucharist with music and incense, a church service.

clue.text: Texture artist, in spirit

indicators.note: in places the artist inside the spirit

parts.note: gin is a spirit
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter's texture comes from being drunk on spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The grain of wood or fabric is its texture, the pattern of its fibres.

clue.text: Very new, good low price

parts.note: so means very, as in 'so good'

explanation.surface: Brand new and in good condition, yet cheap.
explanation.walkthrough: Something bought 'for a song' is bought very cheaply.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'for a song' means for very little money, so a song stands for a bargain price.

clue.text: Shakespearean heroine beat off 25

indicators.note: off means removed, so the beat letters come away from the heroine's name

parts.note: Beatrice is the heroine of Much Ado About Nothing

explanation.surface: A Shakespearean heroine fights off a grain.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 down is GRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Rice is a cereal grass whose seeds are a staple grain.

clue.text: 25% rum has knack of replacing energy

indicators.note: replacing tells us the knack word takes the place of the energy letter

parts.note: rum is an old word for odd or queer
E is the physics symbol for energy
an art is a knack or skill

explanation.surface: A quarter of the rum has a talent for boosting your energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' is the adjective meaning strange, not the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarter is one of four equal parts, i.e. twenty-five percent of the whole.

clue.text: Look disgusted setter's an expert on 25

indicators.note: on places the setter's words after the grain abbreviation

parts.note: 25 down is GRAIN, whose abbreviation as a unit of weight is gr
the setter says 'I am', shortened to I'm
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: The crossword setter pulls a face while boasting of expertise in cereals.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords the setter refers to himself as 'I' or 'me'.
explanation.definitionFit: A grimace is a contorted facial expression, typically of disgust or pain.

clue.text: Golfer essentially jeered boning fish

indicators.note: essentially points to the core, the central letters of each word

parts.note: eels are fish

explanation.surface: A golfer was jeered at basically for filleting fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' takes the middle pair from each of 'jeered' (ER) and 'boning' (NI).
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie Els is a South African professional golfer, a major winner.

clue.text: Tourist destination in Turkey increased all returns

indicators.note: all returns says the whole assembled string is read backwards
in places the increased word inside Turkey's code

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey
rose means increased

explanation.surface: Visitors to a holiday spot in Turkey went up, and everyone comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' makes TROSER, and 'all returns' reads that whole string backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort is a holiday place that tourists visit.
